source.title: Bibelen (Det Norske Bibelselskap, 1930), as shown by the CrossWire SWORD module Norsk
source.attribution: Bibelen 1930 (Bokmål), as shown by CrossWire module Norsk; rights unverified - not for release.
source.provenance: Read on 2026-10-07 from the CrossWire passage-study pages for module Norsk (1 John 1:8-9: https://crosswire.org/study/passagestudy.jsp?mod=Norsk&key=1John+1%3A8-9 and John 3:16: https://crosswire.org/study/passagestudy.jsp?mod=Norsk&key=John+3%3A16); nothing was downloaded. SINGLE-SOURCE READING: an independent reading of the Åpen Bibel repository (Ravatsaas/apen-bibel, Tekst/62 Johannes første brev/001.md and Tekst/43 Johannes/003.md) DISAGREES in two places (1 John 1:9 "tilgir oss syndene" there against "forlater oss syndene" here; John 3:16 "for at" there against "forat" here), so the wording is NOT confirmed against two agreeing sources and no scripture.verification record exists. Rights are unverified: Bibelselskapet says the 1930 translation has "falt i det fri" (https://bibel.no/verbum/rettigheter-til-bruk-av-bibeltekst) without naming a legal basis, and the CrossWire licence statement is not Bibelselskapet's. This sample MUST be replaced or verified before any release.
source.licenseNote: Rights unverified. Bibelselskapet states the 1930 translation has fallen into the public domain; CrossWire labels module Norsk Public Domain; no legal basis checked. Do not ship until a person verifies.

review.notes: Unverified sample: wording read from one source only (CrossWire); the Åpen Bibel text differs in two places. Needs a second, agreeing source or a printed-edition check by a person.

sentences.text: Dersom vi sier at vi ikke har synd, da dårer vi oss selv, og sannheten er ikke i oss;
sentences.english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth isn’t in us.

sentences.text: dersom vi bekjenner våre synder, er han trofast og rettferdig, så han forlater oss syndene og renser oss fra all urettferdighet.
sentences.english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

sentences.text: For så har Gud elsket verden at han gav sin Sønn, den enbårne, forat hver den som tror på ham, ikke skal fortapes, men ha evig liv;
sentences.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
